summary: Resolve human-gate attention from its canonical accepted answer

replay.detail: Point reads reuse durable gate claims and the existing reviewer predicate; no projection or repair.

rules.detail: Original request recipients and admitted winner-time reassignees can obtain the accepted answer actor; current ownership is never consulted.

compatibility.detail: Adds a lower-store proof helper and shared SourceResolution. Missing or unattributed answers return no proof.
